items.title: Kit revision 38: --list Totals count only cases that run; declared skips get their own row
items.spec: testkit/framework.lua renderTotals/renderInventory (about :555-:600). A case registered as a declared skip (Kit.test with a skipReason / Kit.skip, the test record's `skip` field) no longer counts toward any count row: each suite row and `the runner` row count registered NON-skipped cases (a row whose count is 0 is omitted, as now); when the registry holds N>0 declared skips a `| Skipped | N |` row is printed immediately before Total; `| **Total** | **%d** |` is the number of registered non-skipped cases, so Total equals the sum of the suite and runner rows (the Skipped row excluded) and equals the passing count a README badge carries (testing-§5: a skip MUST NOT be folded into passed or total). items.title: Kit revision 38: Kit.secret, a shared secret-value simulator and an opt-in issecretvalue installer
items.spec: New testkit/secrets.lua returning function(Kit), loaded once from testkit/framework.lua beside asserts.lua/inventory.lua through kitFolder() (one load line; framework.lua stays under 1000 lines). Additive surface, all on Kit: Kit.secret(v) returns a wrapper table whose metatable raises an error whose message carries the fixed marker `secret value` (published as Kit.SECRET_ERROR) from __lt, __le, __add, __sub, __mul, __div, __mod, __pow, __unm, __concat, __len, __index, __newindex and __call, and from __eq when compared with another wrapper; Kit.isSecret(v) -> boolean; Kit.reveal(v) -> the plain value (identity for a non-secret); Kit.installSecretValue() sets the global issecretvalue to a function answering Kit.isSecret(v) and returns a restore function that puts back whatever global was there (nil included). The registry is one process-wide weak-keyed table so secrets minted under one mock build stay recognized under the next. Nothing installs issecretvalue by default: mock_base.lua's build is untouched, so no consumer's behaviour changes on re-vendor (fidelity: a client without the global stays modelled). The file header states plainly what Lua 5.1 cannot trap: a boolean test (`if s then`) and `==` against a non-table always succeed, and tostring(s) is not trapped; a test that needs those must assert them explicitly. No consumer local mock is migrated in this run (MultiMeters' tests/mock_secrets.lua models more); WhatGroup (WG-R-02) adopts it after the re-vendor. Kit stays at revision 38 (bumped by LK-01, unreleased): extend docs/api/testkit/version-38-docs.md with the new members (Since 38) and testkit/README.md's file inventory with secrets.lua. New suite tests/test_kit_secrets.lua added to tests/run.lua's SUITES (the suite inventory gate asserts it). CHANGELOG v1.71.0 entry. `cp -r testkit/. tests/_kit/`.

items.title: WidgetsLineChart minor 3: segments clipped to the plot rect, hover re-syncs on every render, formatX locale note
items.spec: LibKa0s/WidgetsLineChart.lua, CHART_MINOR 2 -> 3 (Widgets key 12.1.4.2.1 -> 12.1.4.3.1). (a) Clip (LK-R-01): new pure Math.ClipSegment(x1, y1, x2, y2, left, bottom, right, top) -> x1, y1, x2, y2 or nil (Liang-Barsky), exposed on the ChartMath table beside Math.Dashes. drawSeries clips every segment to the plot rect (s.left, s.bottom, s.left + s.w, s.bottom + s.h) in ONE place before choosing seg or dashed, and skips a segment entirely outside; the single-point tick is drawn only when inside. So Dashes only ever runs over a clipped segment and the number of Line regions a dashed range can create is bounded by plot geometry (about plot diagonal / (DASH+GAP)). Input values are not clamped and markers are not touched. (b) Hover resync (LK-R-03): render() resets c.__hoverIndex to nil (without firing onHover) so the armed OnUpdate re-evaluates against the new scale and data on the next frame and re-fires onHover and the crosshair; when render leaves no scale (no data or zero size) it hides c.__cross. ClearHover keeps working and stays idempotent; a host's explicit ClearHover before repaint is no longer required. (c) Docs (LK-R-10): new docs/api/Widgets/version-12.1.4.3.1-docs.md; the formatX row (old doc :1079) gains one sentence: the default uses date('%d %b'), the C-runtime month abbreviation, so a localized host should pass formatX; the hover note (old :1125-:1129) says re-rendering re-syncs the hover and ClearHover before repaint is no longer needed; ChartMath.ClipSegment documented (Since 3). items.title: WidgetsAutocomplete minor 2: generation-guarded re-hook, set-scripts-first precondition, integral maxRows, backdrop set once
items.spec: LibKa0s/WidgetsAutocomplete.lua, AUTOCOMPLETE_MINOR 1 -> 2 (Widgets key 12.1.4.3.1 -> 12.1.4.3.2). (a) LK-R-02: replace the `hooked[box] = true` once-only guard (hookBox, :345-:349) with a per-box generation: a weak-keyed `generation` table; every lib.Autocomplete call increments generation[box] and installs a fresh set of HookScript wrappers that capture that generation and dispatch only while it is still current, so wrappers from older calls are inert. A re-call after a host SetScript dropped the hooks restores the list; a re-call without SetScript does not double-dispatch. (b) LK-R-07: correct the comment at :67-:68: `owners` entries persist until Release or replacement because the handle references its box (Lua 5.1 has no ephemerons), harmless because client frames live for the session; `generation` holds numbers, so its entries can be collected. (c) LK-R-08: maxRows is floored after the >0 check and falls back to AC.MAX_ROWS when the floored value is below 1 (a dedicated helper beside positive(); rowHeight/minChars unchanged). (d) LK-R-09: SetBackdrop is called once when ensureList creates the list; skin() keeps SetBackdropColor and SetBackdropBorderColor per show so a host restyle still carries over. (e) API doc: the 'Hooks, never scripts' bullet (old doc :1216-:1219) adds that the host should set the box's scripts before calling Autocomplete, that a later SetScript on a hooked script drops the hooks, and that calling lib.Autocomplete again re-installs them (Since 2); maxRows documented as an integer, a fraction is floored. The Widgets major was moved by LK-03 in this release: `git mv` docs/api/Widgets/version-12.1.4.3.1-docs.md to version-12.1.4.3.2-docs.md and extend it, delete the intermediate members json, regenerate. testkit/mock_base.lua already drops HookScript wrappers on SetScript (:155): no kit change. items.spec: automated-tests-§4 / anti-pattern #53: an entry carried as accepted across three consecutive release runs must be fixed or converted to a tracked deviation with an ID and an owner.
